description: Open a LibrePCB workspace, or create a new one if the directory does not exist or is empty. The workspace contains the libraries and is required for all library tools and for adding parts to a project.

path.description: Absolute path to the workspace directory

userName.description: Optional user name, used as author of new elements

name: workspace_open

description: List the libraries available for download from the LibrePCB API server.
name: library_list_remote

description: Download and install (or update) libraries from the LibrePCB API server, including their dependencies.

names.description: Names of the libraries, e.g. 'LibrePCB Base'

name: library_install

description: Search the installed libraries by keyword (case-insensitive substring of name, description or keywords; devices also by part number). An empty query lists all elements. Results are sorted by name.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, default 0

name: library_search

description: Get details of a library element: pins of a symbol; signals, symbol variants, attributes and devices of a component; pads, footprints, pad geometry, courtyard, keep-outs and holes (of one footprint, relative to the origin) of a package; additionally pad-signal-map and parts of a device.

element.description: Name or UUID of the element

footprint.description: Footprint of a package or device, default: the first one

name: library_get

description: Create a new local library in the workspace for your own parts.

dependencies.description: Libraries whose elements are used, e.g. ['LibrePCB Base']

name: library_create

description: Create a schematic symbol with pins and a rectangular body in a local library. Name and value texts are added automatically above and below the body. Returns the result of the symbol check.

bodyFrom.description: One corner of the body rectangle ([x, y] in mm)

bodyTo.description: Opposite corner of the body rectangle ([x, y] in mm)

position.description: Outer end of the pin where wires connect, on the 2.54mm grid ([x, y] in mm)

rotation.description: Direction from the outer end towards the symbol body in degrees: 0 = to the right (pin on the left side), 180 = to the left (pin on the right side), 90 = up, 270 = down

name: symbol_create

description: Create a package with one footprint in a local library: pads, a package outline from the body size, a courtyard around body and pads, name/value texts, and optionally holes, keep-outs and a silkscreen outline with pin 1 marker. The origin should be the center of the body. Returns the result of the package check.

assemblyType.description: Default: derived from the pads; 'none' for footprints without a part to mount, e.g. test pads

body.description: Size [width, height] of the body, centered at the origin, default: around the pads ([x, y] in mm)

courtyardMargin.description: Courtyard distance to body and pads, default 0.25

holes.description: Non-plated holes, e.g. for mounting pegs

keepouts.description: Keep-out zones, e.g. below an antenna or a hole

layers.description: Copper layers, default top (the side of the part, mirrored on the bottom side)

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

legend.description: Draw the body outline and a pin 1 marker on the top silkscreen, default false

drill.description: Drill diameter in mm, makes it a plated THT pad

paste.description: Solder paste on an SMT pad, default true

position.description: Pad center relative to the package origin ([x, y] in mm)

shape.description: Pad shape, default roundrect for SMT and round for THT pads. 'round' with different width and height is an oblong pad. 'custom' takes its outline from 'vertices'.

side.description: Side of an SMT pad, default top

size.description: Pad size [width, height] ([x, y] in mm)

slotLength.description: Total length of a slotted drill along the pad's x axis, 'drill' is its width

vertices.description: Outline of a custom pad, relative to the pad center (closed automatically)

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

name: package_create

description: Create a component from one symbol, or from several gates (e.g. the two halves and the supply of a dual op-amp). One signal is created for each symbol pin, named like the pin; a pin name used in several gates gets the gate suffix ('OUT_A'). Signals are passive and optional unless set in 'signals'; the ERC reports unconnected required signals. Returns the result of the component check.

position.description: Position of the gate when placing the part, default [0, 0] ([x, y] in mm)

symbol.description: Name or UUID of the symbol

signals.description: Properties per signal name, e.g. {"VCC": {"role": "power", "required": true}}

symbol.description: Name or UUID of the symbol of one gate

name: component_create

description: Create a device which maps the signals of a component to the pads of a package. Returns the result of the device check.

component.description: Name or UUID of the component

package.description: Name or UUID of the package

padSignalMap.description: Signal name for each pad name, e.g. {"1": "ADJ"}

name: device_create

description: Open a LibrePCB project (*.lpp). Closes the previously opened project without saving. Unless readOnly is set, the project directory stays locked until it is closed, so it cannot be open in the LibrePCB application at the same time.
name: project_open

description: Close the project without saving and release its lock.
name: project_close

description: Save the project to disk.
name: project_save

description: Get name, version, schematic pages, boards and counts of the open project.
name: project_summary

description: Change the project name, version or author. They appear in title blocks, output file names (version) and via placeholders like {{PROJECT}}, {{VERSION}} and {{AUTHOR}}.
name: project_set_metadata

description: List all parts with designator, value, library component and their placement in schematics and boards (positions in mm).
name: parts_list

description: List all nets with their connected pins ('<designator>.<signal>').
name: netlist_get

description: Run the electrical rule check of the schematics. Each message has an ID (to approve it), the marked areas ('locations', center and size in mm, one message may cover several places) and an explanation, which is given only at the first message with the same explanation.
name: erc_run

description: Approve ERC messages which are fine by intention, so they don't count as open issues anymore. Save the project to keep the approvals.

ids.description: IDs of the messages, as returned by the check

name: erc_approve

description: Run the design rule check of a board (planes are rebuilt first). Each message has an ID (to approve it), the marked areas ('locations', center and size in mm, one message may cover several places) and an explanation, which is given only at the first message with the same explanation.
name: drc_run

description: Approve DRC messages which you reviewed and accept by intention, so they don't count as open issues anymore. Approve only messages you can explain: clearance errors are often real shorts. Save the project to keep the approvals.

ids.description: IDs of the messages, as returned by the check

name: drc_approve

description: Render a schematic page as PNG image, optionally only a region (e.g. at a higher DPI to read details).
name: render_schematic

description: Render a board as PNG image, either with colored layers (good to check placement and routing) or as a realistic rendering. Optionally only a region (e.g. at a higher DPI to inspect details) or only some layers. Returns the mapping from pixels to board coordinates.

layers.description: Only these layers of the 'layers' style, e.g. ['board_copper_top', 'board_outlines'], or also 'board_courtyard_top' or 'board_package_outlines_top' (in magenta). An unknown name lists all names.

name: render_board

description: Create a new project with one schematic page ('Main') and one board ('default', 100x80mm outline) and open it.

path.description: Absolute path of the new *.lpp file, its directory must not exist yet or be empty

name: project_create

description: Undo the last change.
name: undo

description: Redo the last undone change.
name: redo

description: Add a part (a component from the workspace libraries) to a schematic page. Choose a device to define the footprint and part number now, or later with board_place_device. Returns the designator and the pin positions.

attributes.description: Attribute values with unit suffix, e.g. {"RESISTANCE": "100k"} or {"CAPACITANCE": "4.7u"}

component.description: Name or UUID of the component, e.g. 'Capacitor' or 'Diode'

device.description: Optional name or UUID of the device

part.description: Part to order: an MPN of the device (required if the device has several parts), any part as {"mpn": ..., "manufacturer": ...}, or null for none.

position.description: Position, on the 2.54mm grid ([x, y] in mm)

schematic.description: Name or index, default: the first one

symbolVariant.description: Optional symbol variant, as listed by library_get for the component

name: schematic_add_part

description: Connect pins to one net. Each pin gets a short wire with a net label, so pins with the same label are connected without drawing wires across the page. Pins which already have a wire are kept as they are. Supply symbols (e.g. 'Supply GND') force their net name. Pins in a net with an automatic name like 'N1' join the net of the given or forced name.

net.description: Optional net name, e.g. 'VCC'. Without a name an automatic name like 'N3' is used.

name: schematic_connect

description: Draw a wire between two pins on the same schematic page, optionally through corners, and connect them to one net: a pin without net joins the net of the other pin, otherwise a new net is created. Pins of different nets cannot be wired (disconnect one first). Supply symbols force their net name, a net with an automatic name like 'N1' joins the net of that name. Returns the net.
name: schematic_draw_wire

description: Add a text (e.g. a note or a block title) to a schematic page.

position.description: Bottom left corner of the text ([x, y] in mm)

schematic.description: Name or index, default: the first one

name: schematic_add_text

description: Add a schematic page. Nets with the same name connect across pages.
name: schematic_add_page

description: Move, rotate, resize, hide or show the designator ('name') or value text of a part's symbol in the schematic.

gate.description: Gate (symbol suffix, e.g. 'A') of a part with several symbols

name: schematic_set_part_text

description: Remove all wires from pins and disconnect them from their net.
name: schematic_disconnect

description: Rename a net. A net with an automatic name like 'N1' merges into an existing net of the new name.
name: net_rename

description: Create or change a net class and move nets into it, e.g. a class for power nets with wider traces. Nets start in the class 'default'. Trace width and via drill are defaults for new traces and vias (board_route, board_add_via); clearance, width and via drill minimums are checked by the DRC in addition to the board's DRC settings.

defaultTraceWidth.description: Default trace width in mm, null for the board default

defaultViaDrill.description: Default via drill in mm, null for the board default

minClearance.description: Minimum copper clearance to other nets in mm

name: net_class_set

description: Get the value, symbols and pins (position and net) of a part.
name: part_get

description: Change designator, value, attributes or the ordered part number of a part.

attributes.description: Attribute values, e.g. {"RESISTANCE": "2.2k"}. New names add text attributes (e.g. {"TOLERANCE": "1%"}), null removes one.

part.description: Optional part to order: an MPN of the chosen device, any part as {"mpn": ..., "manufacturer": ...}, or null for none

name: part_set_properties

description: Move, rotate or mirror the symbol of a part (one gate of a part with several symbols). Short wires with net labels created by schematic_connect move along, other wires stay attached to the pins. Board traces are not affected.

gate.description: Gate (symbol suffix, e.g. 'A') of a part with several symbols

name: schematic_move_part

description: Remove a part from the schematics (and boards) including its wires.
name: part_remove

description: Replace the board outline, either by a rectangle from (0, 0) to (width, height) or by a polygon. Use board_add_cutout for holes and slots inside the board.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

height.description: Height in mm of a rectangle

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

width.description: Width in mm of a rectangle

name: board_set_outline

description: Add a cutout (a hole or slot milled into the board), either a polygon or a circle.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

center.description: Center of a round cutout ([x, y] in mm)

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

name: board_add_cutout

description: Place a part on the board, or move it if already placed. The device (and thus the package) is taken from the schematic part if chosen there, otherwise it must be given. Returns the pads with their positions and nets. board_query shows what occupies an area.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

device.description: Name or UUID of the device, e.g. 'Capacitor 3216 (1206)'

footprint.description: Optional footprint name of the package

position.description: Position of the part origin ([x, y] in mm)

name: board_place_device

description: Get device, footprint, placement, pads (position, net, layers), courtyard, keep-outs and holes of a part on the board, in board coordinates.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

name: board_get_part

description: Draw a trace on one copper layer between two points of the same net, optionally through corners. An end is a pad ('<designator>.<pad>', e.g. 'U1.8'), a via or junction ID ('via:...', 'point:...'), or a position [x, y] on a trace, junction or via of the net on that layer. A trace there is split into two (new IDs) for a T-junction. To change the layer, end at a via. Without 'width', the default trace width of the net class or else of the board design rules is used (0.5 mm unless changed). Returns the IDs of the new traces, the width, and clearance violations of the new copper from a quick check (the trace is kept; use board_remove_items or undo to revert it). board_query shows which layers are free along a planned path.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

check.description: Check the clearances of the new copper, default true

layer.description: Copper layer: 'top', 'bottom', or 'inner1' to 'innerN' if the board has inner layers

name: board_route

description: Add a through via (connecting all copper layers) to a net. Returns its ID for board_route and clearance violations from a quick check.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

check.description: Check the clearances of the via, default true

drill.description: Optional drill diameter in mm, default from the net class or the design rules

size.description: Optional outer diameter in mm, default from the annular ring design rule

name: board_add_via

description: Add a copper plane (filled area) of a net on a layer, covering the whole board or the given area. It is filled automatically around pads and traces of other nets and is clipped by keep-outs (board_add_keepout).

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

clearance.description: Optional clearance to other copper in mm

connectStyle.description: How pads are connected, default thermal

layer.description: Copper layer: 'top', 'bottom', or 'inner1' to 'innerN' if the board has inner layers

priority.description: Optional priority, overlapping planes with higher priority are filled first, default 0

vertices.description: Optional area, default: whole board (closed automatically)

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

name: board_add_plane

description: Add a keep-out zone where copper, planes, stop mask openings or devices are not allowed, e.g. below a PCB antenna or around a mounting hole.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

layers.description: Copper layers: 'both' (top and bottom, default), 'all' (including inner layers) or one layer like 'top'

rules.description: What is not allowed in the zone, default ['noCopper', 'noPlanes']. 'noCopper' applies to traces, vias and pads, 'noExposure' to stop mask openings.

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

name: board_add_keepout

description: Add a text to the board, e.g. product name, version or connector labels on the silkscreen (legend). Texts on bottom layers are mirrored automatically. Placeholders like {{PROJECT}}, {{VERSION}} or {{BOARD}} are substituted.

align.description: Horizontal alignment at the anchor, default left. The anchor is always at the bottom of the text.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

position.description: Anchor of the text, see 'align' ([x, y] in mm)

name: board_add_text

description: Move, rotate, resize, hide or show the designator ('name') or value text of placed parts, e.g. to keep it off pads and other parts. Several parts can be given to change them alike (e.g. hide all values).

align.description: New horizontal alignment at the anchor, which is then at the bottom of the text as with board_add_text. Footprint texts are often centered on their anchor.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

position.description: New anchor position ([x, y] in mm)

name: board_set_part_text

description: Add a non-plated hole (NPTH), e.g. for a mounting screw without a footprint.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

name: board_add_hole

description: List the items on a board with their IDs (for board_modify_item, board_remove_items and board_route), optionally only some types, those of a net, on a layer or overlapping an area. Types: traces, vias, points (junctions and corners of traces), planes, keepouts, polygons (board outline, cutouts, drawings), texts (including the name/value texts of parts), holes (NPTH) and pads.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

layer.description: Only items on this layer: a copper layer ('top', 'bottom', 'inner1', ...) or a layer ID like 'top_legend' or 'brd_cutouts'

types.description: Item types to list, default all except pads and points

name: board_list_items

description: Show what is inside a rectangle of the board, to find free space for parts, traces and vias before placing them: the parts reaching into it (with their courtyard box and the pads inside), the traces passing through it as whole paths (from end to end, with the trace IDs in order), vias, holes, keep-outs (also those of parts), texts with their box and the planes covering it. Items count when their actual shape overlaps the rectangle. 'free' tells for each copper layer whether the rectangle holds no pad, trace or via of any net (planes keep their clearance by themselves), 'withinBoard' whether it lies inside the board outline and off cutouts. To check whether a trace or via fits, query the area it would cover, enlarged by the clearance, with its net. Keep the rectangle small, the whole board gives a long answer.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

net.description: Optional net whose own copper does not count as blocking in 'free'

name: board_query

description: Remove board items by their IDs (see board_list_items). 'net:<name>' removes all traces and vias of a net. Removing a junction removes its traces. Pads are removed with their part (part_remove).

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

name: board_remove_items

description: Change a board item given by its ID (see board_list_items). Fields per type: trace: width, layer. via: position, drill, size. point (junction or corner): position. plane: vertices, layer, net, priority, connectStyle, clearance. keepout: vertices, layers, rules. polygon: vertices. text: text, position, rotation, height, align, layer. hole: position, diameter. Traces follow moved vias and points.

align.description: New horizontal alignment, anchored at the bottom

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

drill.description: New via drill diameter in mm

layer.description: New layer: copper layer name for traces and planes, layer ID like 'top_legend' for texts

layers.description: New keep-out layers: 'both', 'all' or one layer

size.description: New via outer diameter in mm

items.description: [x, y] in mm, or [x, y, angle] to draw an arc with this angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise) to the next vertex

name: board_modify_item

description: Get the board setup: inner copper layer count, PCB thickness, design rules (defaults for new traces and vias), DRC settings (minimum values), net classes with their nets, and the available design rule presets of PCB manufacturers (for board_set_settings).

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

name: board_get_settings

description: Change the board setup: apply a design rule preset of a PCB manufacturer, set inner copper layers (named 'inner1' ... in other tools), PCB thickness, defaults for new traces and vias, and DRC minimum values. Net classes are set with net_class_set.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

defaultTraceWidth.description: Default width of new traces in mm (if the net class has none)

defaultViaDrill.description: Default drill of new vias in mm (if the net class has none)

minCopperBoardClearance.description: DRC minimum in mm: Copper to board edge

minCopperClearance.description: DRC minimum in mm: Copper to copper of other nets

minCopperNpthClearance.description: DRC minimum in mm: Copper to non-plated holes

minCopperWidth.description: DRC minimum in mm: Copper width

minDrillBoardClearance.description: DRC minimum in mm: Drill to board edge

minDrillDrillClearance.description: DRC minimum in mm: Drill to drill

minNpthDrill.description: DRC minimum in mm: Drill diameter of non-plated holes

minOutlineToolDiameter.description: DRC minimum in mm: Milling tool diameter for inner corners

minPthAnnularRing.description: DRC minimum in mm: Annular ring of plated holes

minPthDrill.description: DRC minimum in mm: Drill diameter of plated holes

minSilkscreenTextHeight.description: DRC minimum in mm: Silkscreen text height

minSilkscreenWidth.description: DRC minimum in mm: Silkscreen line width

preset.description: Design rule preset of a PCB manufacturer as listed by board_get_settings, or 'default'. Applied first, then the other values.

name: board_set_settings

description: Get the routing status of a board: unplaced parts, placed parts and the unrouted connections (air wires). Planes are filled first.

board.description: Board name or index, default: the first one

name: board_status

description: Generate the production data (Gerber/Excellon, assembly and schematic PDFs, pick&place, BOM, archives) into the project's output directory. Adds the default set of output jobs if the project has none yet (saved with project_save).
name: output_jobs_run
